title: Compliance labels (CWE, CERT, MISRA)
summary: Rules carry CWE / CERT / MISRA ids; --labels prints them, rules --standard filters by standard, JSON gains a compliance field
intro: Read this when you must show which lint rules map to CWE, CERT or MISRA, or restrict a run to one standard. Labelled findings print their ids with --labels, and the cwe, cert, misra and cwe-top25 profiles select the labelled rules.
